summary: Universe Pharmaceuticals INC filed a Form 6-K reporting the adoption of its 2026 Equity Incentive Plan and a grant of 71,890 Class A and 12,610 Class B ordinary shares to CEO Gang Lai as compensation for past services. The shares were issued on May 7, 2026. Post-issuance, Lai and his holding company beneficially own about 75.0% voting power. This is a routine equity grant and not a special situation.
